# GrowthSpare — AI & LLM Site Overview
> https://growthspare.com

GrowthSpare is a premier digital marketing agency and enterprise technology engineering firm based in New Delhi (Indure House, 2nd Floor, Savitri Cinema Complex GK-II, New Delhi, Delhi 110048).
We combine high-performance organic SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, custom AI chatbots, workflow automation, and custom Next.js/ERP/CRM software development under one roof.

## Key Services
- **Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**: Technical audits, on-page optimization, backlink acquisition, and local Delhi NCR / Gurgaon / Noida search dominance. URL: https://growthspare.com/services/seo
- **Google Ads & PPC Management**: High-ROAS search, shopping, display, and Performance Max campaigns. URL: https://growthspare.com/services/ppc
- **AI Chatbots & Agents**: Custom conversational AI chatbots, customer support routing, and WhatsApp AI automations. URL: https://growthspare.com/services/ai-chatbots
- **AI & Workflow Automation**: End-to-end operational automation for lead routing, document processing, and data synchronization. URL: https://growthspare.com/services/ai-automation
- **Web & Mobile App Development**: Ultra-fast Next.js storefronts, React Native mobile apps, and headless CMS integrations. URL: https://growthspare.com/services/web-development
- **Custom ERP & CRM Systems**: Cloud enterprise platforms built with modern TypeScript, Supabase, and microservice architectures. URL: https://growthspare.com/services/erp
